ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio favoring white (high-intensity) pixels covering approximately 85% of the visible surface, with a sharp, low-intensity (black) border mapping the entire perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity (black) band along the trailing edge, thickening at the distal tips and central notch; isolated dark circular focal spot in the lower-left quadrant; predominantly uniform high-intensity white across the central lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe horizontal planes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel amplitudes (10-30 pixels) observed across the entire continuous boundary, isolated from the high-contrast water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature fitted to both lobes, tapering to irregular, jagged distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, three-dimensional high-contrast cluster of irregular white and grey pixel blobs localized on the extreme left distal tip (barnacle colonization); similar smaller-scale cluster on the extreme right tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple faint, unaligned vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated on the right lobe surface and one distinct mark on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of parasitic barnacles on the left fluke tip creating an irregular physical profile; distinct dark oval scar located in the lower-left quadrant of the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced black pigmentation intrusion ('drip' pattern) extending from the trailing edge border into the white surface area adjacent to the median notch.
